message: So, we had a blackout last week, and let me tell you, my kids were both excited and confused! It's amazing how quickly they adapted to the 'adventure' of no power. I found this handy resource from the Red Cross that lays out some great tips on how to prepare for power outages. It’s a nice reminder that being ready can turn a little chaos into family bonding time. What fun activities do you think you’d do during a blackout?
